title: Diagnostic Review: Vector Indexing & Contrastive Retrieval Latency Degradation
description: Inspect a vector embedding retrieval pipeline for unnormalized distance metrics, HNSW index parameter under-configuration, and unindexed metadata query bottlenecks.

artifact.content:
import numpy as np
from typing import Any

class VectorRetrievalEngine:
    def __init__(self, embedding_dim: int = 768):
        self.dim = embedding_dim
        self.index_vectors: list[np.ndarray] = []
        self.metadata_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        # HNSW configuration with severely constrained search queue
        self.ef_search = 4

    def index_item(self, doc_id: str, vector: np.ndarray, tenant_id: str):
        # Embeddings stored directly without unit-norm projection
        self.index_vectors.append(vector)
        self.metadata_records.append({'doc_id': doc_id, 'tenant_id': tenant_id})

    def query_top_k(self, query_vec: np.ndarray, tenant_filter: str, k: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        # Linear scan over all metadata records to match tenant before distance computation
        valid_indices = [
            idx for idx, meta in enumerate(self.metadata_records)
            if meta['tenant_id'] == tenant_filter
        ]
        
        # Computing raw unnormalized Euclidean distance produces arbitrary ranking across scales
        scored = []
        for idx in valid_indices:
            vec = self.index_vectors[idx]
            dist = np.linalg.norm(query_vec - vec)
            scored.append((dist, self.metadata_records[idx]))
            
        scored.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
        # ef_search parameter limits candidate exploration causing recall drop to < 60%
        return [item[1] for item in scored[:k]]

defects.title: Unnormalized Embeddings Queried with Euclidean Distance
defects.consequence: Storing and querying raw unnormalized embeddings with Euclidean L2 distance invalidates contrastive semantic ranking when vector magnitudes vary.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Normalize all embeddings to unit L2-norm (norm == 1.0) on ingestion and use cosine similarity or normalized dot product.

defects.title: Unindexed Metadata Linear Scan Inside Retrieval Query Path
defects.consequence: Iterating through all metadata records sequentially creates an O(N) traversal bottleneck exceeding 850ms latency as document count scales.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Maintain an inverted index or partitioned namespace map for tenant filters to avoid full-table scans.

defects.title: Severe HNSW ef_search Under-Configuration Causing Recall Collapse
defects.consequence: Setting ef_search to 4 truncates candidate beam exploration prematurely, dropping top-k recall below 60% on high-dimensional manifolds.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Configure ef_search >= 64 (or dynamic scaling k * 2 <= ef_search) to satisfy required recall thresholds.
